CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2792 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 63b811ab527c908d05a3aff27e344edeba091976. Bus nonce: e784c47f06e9ea06015f51f3802543eb. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 63b811ab527c908d05a3aff27e344edeba091976`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 63b811ab527c908d05a3aff27e344edeba091976` or `Fix review: blocked 63b811ab527c908d05a3aff27e344edeba091976 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: e784c47f06e9ea06015f51f3802543eb`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `63b811ab527c908d05a3aff27e344edeba091976` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2792 63b811ab527c908d05a3aff27e344edeba091976") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2792-e784c47f`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Review #2792 (R10-FLOW-ROSTER-FREEZE arm (a), the relay freeze; critical path; Lean flow study K13; arm (b) merged as #2779) at its live head, with the finder's harness at both ends. Group brief and its six carries: read them from origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster (dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json, group R10-FLOW-ROSTER-FREEZE). Check: (a) the relay (tools/audit/seat/cloud_relay.sh) does not move an open roster pull request's head while a review of it is in flight (a review worktree or an undisposed review dispatch for that number), and moves it once the review posts; run the relay fixture with a review in flight and without it (null control: head moves), and the mutant for the arm must be killed; (b) the six carries are each discharged in the diff or answered in the body's Forward-carry: hold-file grammar (plain PR-number lines only, remove only your own line, read back only through `cloud_relay.sh held`, one malformed line refuses the whole handoff arm rc 2 with `OWED <utc> handoff-hold-malformed <file> -`; nine malformed variants and the null control `a well-formed hold file owes no refusal`), P-H hold on a git-read merge verdict at the head (verdict/<pr> tip subject `Fix review: merge <head>` equals the PR's current head), the seam with R10-ORCH-MACHINERY (live reviewer from the design's workers.json when it exists), self-test hygiene (per-file mutant id inside the instrument's block, throwaway_git.py, PUSHERS registered in ref_privacy.py, Red checks answered), and card 1 (the standing roster seat retires only when its replacement beat job is live and verified: do NOT accept an inline-in-orchestrator replacement); a carry neither discharged nor answered is a carry-missing block. carry_audit.py is code-owned (tvofi's review under the mandate): say so in the verdict. structure.py must exit 0 at the head; three-dot diffs only; a null control for every quantified claim.
No host or home paths in anything you push; cite repo-relative paths only (app_comment.sh refuses an account name).
